item.name: Build_Book
item.description: Current camp-specific build and strike drawings, part counts, connection details, anchor locations, crew requirements, lift sequence, and final-state photographs for each structure.
item.readyBeforeUse: The page for the current asset is complete and approved by the responsible lead.
item.readyForNextPerson: The book remains complete and at the build station.
item.ifNotReady: Do not build, alter, or strike the affected asset. Tell the Build Lead.
